limitations: This is not an as-of-2018 or prospective experiment. Current MeSH assignments, descriptor trees and hand-written axis rules may encode later knowledge.

The stored-year parser prefers Journal/JournalIssue/PubDate/Year, then ArticleDate/Year, then the leading year of Journal/PubDate/MedlineDate. This is not when the record, abstract or indexing became available. Electronic and print dates can differ; source date kinds are not retained separately.

The endpoint is exact descriptor-UI co-occurrence in this early-detection corpus, not all PubMed work, scientific novelty, feasibility or clinical benefit. It does not apply PubMed's descendant-term query expansion to each pairing.
MEDLINE indexing changed toward full automation in April 2022; vocabulary changes and back-indexing can create apparent changes in co-occurrence.

Matching is conditional on the same disease and a training method-frequency bin. It does not adjust method age, topic trends or every relevant confounder. Unmatched flagged cells are excluded from the matched comparison and listed.

Bootstrap intervals are descriptive, conditional on the fixed axes, matches and ontology. They resample diseases, not independent cells. Shared methods and papers can still correlate different disease clusters; this is not corrected.

The observed corpus is not a random sample of research opportunities. Few disease clusters, partial final years and changing indexing limit inference. Intervals do not account for retrieval, ontology or indexing uncertainty.
The three thresholds are exploratory sensitivity checks, without a multiple-comparison adjustment or a preregistered confirmatory hypothesis.
The historical 2x lift remains withdrawn and corrected prospective validation remains pending, regardless of these exploratory results.
requirements_for_original_effect_validat: The original ranker source revision, exact parameters, frozen candidate population, selected examples and original numerical outputs.
Archived query text, returned PMID lists, full source records and a reconciled retrieval log for the original train and holdout corpora.

Records and indexing exactly as available at the historical cutoff, including record/abstract/index availability dates and a versioned historical ontology; current publication-year filtering is not a substitute.
A predefined endpoint and eligibility/date rules separating corpus co-occurrence from historically scoped full-PubMed novelty judgments.
An independent, time-frozen evaluation set, appropriate controls, a specified uncertainty model and expert adjudication if claiming scientific usefulness.
